title: Check the approved change
responsibility: Checks that a Change request still names the approved design, contract, images and thread.

inputs.name: approvalMatch.entity
inputs.description: The entity details, including its latest version, contract hash, last design version’s approval and threads.

inputs.name: approvalMatch.request
inputs.description: The requested mode, thread and approval binding. Plan requests pass without an approval check. A Change must identify the current approved version, contract, image hashes and design option.

outputs.name: approvalMatch
outputs.description: No return value. Returning normally means the applicable approval and thread checks passed; it does not execute or verify a change.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Refuses a missing or outdated approval, a different design or contract, different image hashes or option, a thread outside this entity, or a thread anchored to another version or option. Image hash order is ignored, but the complete sorted lists must match.
